A group's season computed by the leaderboard's Elo with other weights, every game's breakdown, and how well the ratings predict the next game over all seasons. Weights left out stay at the season's (its settings'); without seasonId the running season.

parameters.description: The group's invite code; it is all the simulator needs to open a group.

post.description: Like GET, with made-up test games counted where they say and the group's running live matches (teams as the app reduces them from their ops) counted as if they ended now. Nothing is stored. The standings then compare with the stored games alone. With a replay, the response's replay rates one stored match after every step of its live log, then as stored.

put.description: Replaces all the profile's score clips (the videos Versus TV and the app play one of when the player scores) with a new one, and answers where to upload it.

post.description: Adds a score clip next to the profile's others (at most 10; one plays at random when the player scores), and answers where to upload it.

delete.description: Removes one of the profile's score clips.

get.description: Every match of the season with each player's Elo change in it (the rating after it minus before), from the same replay as the season leaderboard.

post.description: The leaderboard with live matches counted as if they ended now: until a finish decides a match, the team that took more cups wins; a tie is a draw. The client sends the teams, since only clients reduce a live match's op log. Nothing is stored.

after.description: "start", "end", or the id of the season's game it comes right after.

EloReplayDto.description: A stored match of the season and the teams after every step of its live log.

rank.description: Place among the ranked players; null while unranked.

share.description: The player's share of the game's own points, set before it.
The team's share of the game's own points, set before it.

testIndex.description: The test game's place in the request; null for real games.

liveMatchId.description: The running live match this game is, counted as if it ended now; null for other games.

points.description: Own points both teams scored, what the shares are of.

fullPoints.description: Own points of an average full game before this one; an average player scores fullPoints / 2 / team size.

ring.description: What the result counted: more than 1 for a ring win.

baseline.description: What the standings' baseline values compare with: the season's weights, or with test or live games the same weights without them.

replay.description: The requested replay: the match after every step, last as stored; empty without one.

id.description: The app's id for a new match (a UUID). Creating a match with an id that already exists in the season returns that match instead of saving a copy.

eloK.description: Elo: rating for scoring, above your share, what an average player in your spot scores in a full game (at swing 1). Responses have the weight in effect; in an update a missing weight stays and null is the default.

eloKr.description: Elo: rating at stake on the result (at swing 1).

eloRingWeight.description: Elo: a ring win counts (ring bonus / normal finish bonus) to this power: 0 like a normal win, 0.5 the square root, 1 the ratio.

eloSwing.description: Elo: how far ratings move and spread, without changing who's ahead.

scoreClipUrls.description: the videos Versus TV and the app play one of at random when the player scores, oldest first

drawn.description: SET_RERACK: where each of `cups` is drawn, pairwise; both empty puts the team's cups back in the pyramid

formationId.description: SET_RERACK: the saved formation the cups were re-racked into

LiveMatchDisplayDto.description: A live match's score as the app shows it, computed at seq (the live match's lastSeq).

teams.description: [blue, red] as the match would be entered now, for the players' live Elo on the widget

moves.description: the cup hits so far, newest first (at most 10)

blueCups.description: the blue team's own cups as they're drawn, for the Live Activity: three digits per cup, its x and y on the 7x7 grid and 1 if it's still standing

redCups.description: the red team's own cups, like blueCups

avatar.description: the avatar's asset id; the Live Activity shows the app's small copy of it

LiveMoveDto.description: a cup hit: who, on which team, with which move

score.description: the score right after it, e.g. "2–0"

accepted.description: false if seq isn't the live match's lastSeq (or it ended): nothing changed

PushTokensDto.description: The calling phone's APNs tokens. A null token is forgotten; no activityStartToken means no Live Activities.
